about.heading: Explore Our Curated L&D Resources that Bring Agility to Your Day to Day Operations
paragraphs: We know how hard it is to find decent training materials that aren't just generic advice or sales pitches. That's why we've put together this L&D Hub. It's a collection of practical tools designed specifically for people running training programs and managing teams.

While popular course aggregators and online training providers focus heavily on delivering generic courses, they often lack deep expertise in the complex L&D ecosystem. As a leading corporate training and L&D consulting service provider, Edstellar understands the real world pulse of the industry and the specific challenges HR leaders face daily.

We've moved beyond simple skill-building to address the strategic gaps that aggregators ignore, like building a training budget or mapping out a competency matrix. Edstellar's Learning and Development resources fill that gap with **over 500 hand-picked and expertly created L&D resources**, from TNA templates to guides on HR tech, designed to speed up your daily workflows and help you reach your organization's L&D targets more efficiently.

Everything here is free to download. We've done the research and the vetting, so you can stop searching and start building better training programs. Join thousands of HR leads who use these tools to keep their teams' skills sharp.

faqs.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.description: Can't find what you need? Write to contact@edstellar.com and we'll add it to the library.

items.question: How can L&D professionals benefit from this collection of L&D resources?
items.answer: HR and L&D leaders can use these learning and development resources to skip the manual work of building training frameworks from scratch. Whether you need to run a skills gap analysis, plan a yearly budget, or set up a competency matrix, these L&D resources provide a vetted starting point that saves hours of research and document creation.

items.question: Where can I find specific learning and development templates for training planning?
items.answer: You can access our dedicated library of learning and development templates which include customizable Excel and Word files. These L&D resources are designed to help you streamline everything from training registers to skill gap assessments.

items.question: Why are these L&D resources provided for free?
items.answer: We believe that access to high-quality learning and development resources shouldn't be a barrier to organizational growth. By providing these L&D resources for free, we help L&D managers prove the value of their programs without initial overhead.

items.question: Can I suggest a specific L&D resource if I can't find it here?
items.answer: Yes, we encourage it. If there is a specific template, checklist, or guide you need that isn't currently in our library of learning and development resources, please reach out to us. We regularly update our L&D resources based on direct feedback from professionals.

items.question: What corporate training courses can L&D leads access through Edstellar?
items.answer: Beyond our free L&D resources, Edstellar provides instructor-led corporate training. L&D leads can access 5,000+ instructor-led corporate training courses through Edstellar across leadership, management, soft skills, IT, compliance, and sustainability. The programs are customizable and delivered online, onsite, or offsite to fit business needs. Edstellar also supports training with skill gap analysis and end-to-end training management.

items.question: What L&D consulting services are available for more complex needs?
items.answer: For organizations requiring a more tailored approach, we offer L&D consulting services to help design custom learning journeys and optimize your overall talent development strategy using professional learning and development resources.
